title: The Jagged Crown (Stormcloaks)
description: After joining the Stormcloaks, Galmar Stone-Fist sends the player to retrieve the Jagged Crown from the ruins of Korvanjund. The player fights through Imperial soldiers and draugr, solves a puzzle door, and retrieves the crown from a boss-level draugr before delivering it to Ulfric Stormcloak in Windhelm.

base_facts: I am Galmar Stone-Fist, second-in-command of the Stormcloak Rebellion.
I know the Jagged Crown lies in the ruins of Korvanjund.
I lead Stormcloak forces on expeditions to reclaim important artifacts.

TALK_TO_GALMAR: I have given the recruit the mission to retrieve the Jagged Crown from Korvanjund.
MEET_GALMAR_KORVANJUND: I am leading the assault on Korvanjund to retrieve the Jagged Crown.
RETRIEVE_CROWN: The Jagged Crown has been found. I told the recruit to take it straight to Ulfric.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I remained behind at Korvanjund to search the ruins for anything else of use while the recruit delivered the Jagged Crown.
The Jagged Crown has been successfully retrieved from Korvanjund and delivered to Ulfric.

base_facts: I am Ulfric Stormcloak, Jarl of Windhelm and leader of the Stormcloak Rebellion.
The Jagged Crown is a symbol of legitimacy for the High King of Skyrim.

DELIVER_CROWN: The Jagged Crown has been delivered to me. This strengthens our claim to rule Skyrim.
GET_NEW_ORDERS: I have given new orders for the next phase of the campaign.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have received the Jagged Crown from the recruit, securing a powerful symbol of legitimacy for the Stormcloak Rebellion.
I am immediately tasking the recruit with delivering a message to Balgruuf in Whiterun for the next phase of the campaign.

base_facts: I am a Stormcloak soldier loyal to Ulfric's cause.
I joined the expedition to Korvanjund.

MEET_GALMAR_KORVANJUND: I am at Korvanjund with Galmar and the other Stormcloaks, ready to fight.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I fought alongside the recruit and Galmar through the ruins of Korvanjund to retrieve the Jagged Crown.
The Jagged Crown has been delivered to Ulfric, marking a significant victory for the Stormcloaks.
